card.name: First digit of section numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that starts a section number such as 7.1 or 2.1 right after a closing parenthesis, in the highlights list of a drug label. It also fires on some digits inside doses and volumes.

modes.label: Section number start
modes.description: The first digit of a numbered heading, which repeats the number of the cross-reference just before it.

modes.label: Digits in doses
modes.description: A digit within a dose or volume figure in a dosing table.

card.plain: It marks the first digit of a numbered section heading in a drug label's contents list.
